description: Election Commission - Declare that, D. M. Rathnayaka as a member of the Siyambalanduwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Siyambalanduwa Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's death, following procedures outlined in the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member through an electoral process, which falls under election-related matters.
